question.prompt: Name a dance, trend, or challenge that went viral on TikTok.
question.criteria: A named dance, recurring video format, food trend, or participatory challenge widely documented as having gone viral on TikTok.

answers.evidence: Renegade is a viral dance created by Jalaiah Harmon to K Camp's song Lottery.
TikTok users recreated Wednesday Addams's dance from Wednesday, frequently pairing it with a sped-up version of Bloody Mary.
Keara Wilson's choreography to Megan Thee Stallion's Savage became a viral TikTok dance.
Haley Sharpe's choreography to Doja Cat's Say So became a widely copied TikTok dance.
A dance challenge set to The Weeknd's Blinding Lights spread widely on TikTok.
Flip the Switch videos show participants swapping outfits or positions when the lights switch off during Drake's Nonstop.
Wipe It Down videos use mirror-cleaning transitions to reveal a changed appearance.

aliases: Tell me without telling me challenge

answers.evidence: This TikTok format asks people to demonstrate something about themselves without stating it directly.
Pass the Brush videos link makeup transformations by making a makeup brush appear to pass between participants.
TikTok users collaboratively created songs and theatrical concepts for an unofficial Ratatouille musical.
Blanco Brown's The Git Up inspired a viral line-dance challenge on TikTok.
Videos of whipped instant coffee served over milk became a major TikTok recipe trend.
Baked feta pasta became a viral TikTok recipe featuring a block of feta roasted with tomatoes.
The Roman Empire trend featured people asking men how often they thought about ancient Rome.
Drake's Toosie Slide inspired TikTok dance videos following its directional dance instructions.
The Don't Rush challenge uses coordinated transitions to show participants changing from casual looks to dressed-up looks.
TikTok creators used duets to build layered sea-shanty performances, with Wellerman becoming a breakout song.
The Microwave Challenge features people rotating while seated on the floor as though turning inside a microwave.
The I'm Just a Kid challenge recreates childhood photographs to Simple Plan's song I'm Just a Kid.

question.explanation: TikTok trends include choreographed dances, transformation videos, recipe crazes, and repeatable jokes. A trend can qualify even if it originated elsewhere before spreading on TikTok.

provenance.brief: Name a widely known TikTok dance, trend or challenge.

Renegade.reason: Jalaiah Harmon's dance to K Camp's "Lottery" was a widely documented viral TikTok dance.

Wednesday Dance.reason: Recreations of Wednesday Addams's dance went viral, often using a sped-up version of Lady Gaga's "Bloody Mary."

Savage.reason: Keara Wilson's choreography to Megan Thee Stallion's "Savage" became a major TikTok dance trend.

Say So.reason: Haley Sharpe's dance to Doja Cat's "Say So" went viral on TikTok.

Blinding Lights.reason: The dance challenge set to The Weeknd's "Blinding Lights" was widely popular on TikTok.

Flip the Switch.reason: This viral challenge used Drake's "Nonstop" and a light-switch transition to reveal participants swapping outfits or roles.

Wipe It Down.reason: The viral mirror-wiping challenge used transitions to reveal transformed appearances.

Tell Me Without Telling Me.reason: This widely documented TikTok format asks users to communicate something indirectly through examples or demonstrations.

Pass the Brush.reason: This viral makeup-transformation format linked participants through apparent passes of a makeup brush.

Ratatouille Musical.reason: A viral TikTok collaboration produced songs and concepts for an unofficial Ratatouille musical.

The Git Up.reason: Blanco Brown's song inspired a widely documented viral line-dance challenge on TikTok.

Dalgona Coffee.reason: Whipped instant coffee over milk became a major viral TikTok food trend in 2020.

Baked Feta Pasta.reason: Pasta made with oven-roasted feta and tomatoes became a widely documented TikTok recipe craze.

Roman Empire.reason: Asking men how often they think about the Roman Empire became a viral TikTok format.

Toosie Slide.reason: Drake's song and its directional dance instructions inspired a viral TikTok dance challenge.

Don't Rush.reason: The viral challenge featured coordinated transitions from casual clothing to dressed-up appearances.

Sea Shanty TikTok.reason: Layered sea-shanty duets, especially performances of "Wellerman," became a major TikTok trend.

Microwave Challenge.reason: This documented viral challenge involved rotating while seated on the floor, imitating a microwave turntable.

I'm Just a Kid.reason: Recreating childhood photographs to Simple Plan's "I'm Just a Kid" became a viral TikTok challenge.
